jobs.title: AI Architect & Engineer to build a robust MVP.
jobs.description:
📌 Summary
We are seeking a hands-on, execution-focused AI Architect / Full-Stack Engineer to transition an early proof-of-concept (built in Lovable.dev) into a production-grade, scalable Minimum Viable Product (MVP). In this greenfield role, you will take the rapid frontend prototype and auto-generated codebase produced by Lovable, refactor and harden it, and engineer the underlying AI services, APIs, and data infrastructure required for a live commercial build.
As the technical lead on the MVP, you will bridge AI-assisted rapid development tools with production software engineering standards. You will evaluate the existing Lovable frontend, build or integrate custom backend services (e.g., Supabase, Node.js, Python), and construct reliable LLM workflows. If you excel at taking 0-to-1 concepts from initial AI prototype to scalable production software, this role offers an ideal technical platform.
🏢 General Information (About the Client)
Our client is an innovative software organization focused on bringing intelligent, AI-powered tools to market quickly. Having validated early market interest with a working prototype created via Lovable (the AI web app builder), they are ready to harden the application for enterprise-scale performance, security, and reliability.
They operate within an agile, builder-first environment that leverages modern AI-assisted development tools to speed up delivery cycles. They value senior technical leads who can assess prototype code critically, establish robust engineering baselines, and make pragmatic architectural trade-offs to deliver a polished MVP to end users.
🗝️ Tasks and Deliverables
Lovable Prototype Refactoring: Audit, refactor, and harden the frontend codebase and UI components generated during the Lovable.dev POC phase to ensure long-term maintainability, clean state management, and performance.
MVP Architecture & Backend Build: Architect and deploy production-ready backend services, database schemas, and API endpoints (utilizing Supabase, Node.js/TypeScript, or Python).
AI & LLM Pipeline Engineering: Design and integrate production AI capabilities, including prompt engineering, context management, foundation model APIs (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI), and vector search workflows.
Database & State Management: Set up scalable relational and vector data structures, establishing clear authentication, data security, and environment configurations.
Full-Stack Deployment & CI/CD: Establish automated deployment pipelines, repository workflows (GitHub), and cloud hosting configurations for the MVP.
Technical Roadmap & Handoff: Document core system architecture, data flows, and operational runbooks for seamless platform extension post-launch.
✅ Required Experience
0-to-1 MVP Development: Proven track record taking software products from early prototype/POC to a fully deployed, production-grade MVP.
Experience with AI Web Builders (Lovable): Direct experience or familiarity working with Lovable.dev (or comparable AI development platforms like v0, Bolt.new, or Cursor), with the technical ability to clean, refactor, and extend generated React/TypeScript codebases.
Modern Web Stack Proficiency: Strong mastery of modern frontend frameworks (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) and backend ecosystems (Supabase, PostgreSQL, Node.js/Express, or Python/FastAPI).
AI & LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating foundation model APIs, structured JSON outputs, function calling, RAG frameworks, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector).
Pragmatic Architecture Judgment: Ability to balance delivery speed with production code quality—knowing when to preserve rapid prototype elements versus when to rebuild for security, scale, and performance.
Preferred Qualifications (Plus):
Deep experience with Supabase backend architectures (Auth, Row Level Security, Edge Functions).
Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and cloud deployments (Vercel, AWS, or GCP).
📢 Engagement Highlights
Greenfield Product Ownership: Lead the evolution of an active POC into a live, market-ready AI platform, making foundational architecture decisions from Day 1.
Modern AI Tech Stack: Work natively at the intersection of AI app builders (Lovable), modern TypeScript/React frontends, Supabase backends, and cutting-edge LLMs.
High-Speed Execution: Enjoy a lean, focused engineering environment where rapid prototyping directly translates into commercial deployment without corporate friction.

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer (Next.js & Supabase)
jobs.description:
Summary
We are seeking a Security Engineer to conduct a full pre-launch security audit for a marketplace platform with critical trust infrastructure and Banking-as-a-Service integrations. The engagement is focused on testing the platform and delivering a clear audit report before launch.
General information
The platform is a car marketplace that is ready for prelaunch and requires a complete security review before going live. The application is built with Next.js and TypeScript, uses Supabase and PostgreSQL, includes RLS and real-time systems, and is deployed on Vercel.
The current scope is an audit engagement rather than certification issuance. The platform also includes third-party integrations such as a payment gateway and a car check provider.
Tasks and Deliverables
Conduct a full pre-launch security audit of the marketplace platform.
Test the platform and identify security risks across the application stack.
Deliver a clear audit report with findings and recommendations.
Review the security posture of Banking-as-a-Service integrations.
Assess security considerations across RLS and real-time system components.
Required experience
Proven experience conducting application security audits.
Experience testing modern web applications built with Next.js and TypeScript.
Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and security considerations around RLS.
Experience reviewing production web architectures and real-time systems.
Ability to deliver actionable security findings in a written audit report.

jobs.title: Front-End Focused Full-Stack Developer – Data Science & Agentic AI Web App for Cosmetics gigant
jobs.description:
Summary
A global enterprise is building a new data science-driven initiative focused on understanding what's really driving sales performance across its business. The project is still in its framing phase—the team knows the business question they want to answer, but they're still working out the right technical approach, and they want a proof of concept that looks and feels close to a real product, not a slide deck. Today, most of this kind of work lives in PowerBI dashboards, but there's a clear push to move toward a proper web application that can eventually support a mix of dashboard-style visualizations and an AI-driven chat interface. We're looking for a full-stack developer with a strong front-end lean (React) who can partner closely with data scientists and data engineers, help the team visualize what's technically possible, and build a convincing, demo-ready application that can be shown to leadership to help secure continued investment in the project.
Tasks and Deliverables
Build a proof-of-concept web application (React front end) that moves the team's sales-driver analysis beyond static PowerBI dashboards
Design and implement a UI that combines dashboard-style data visualization components with an embedded AI chat/agentic interface
Work closely with data science and data engineering team members to surface model outputs (which may range from a simple decision tree to a full ML model or agentic system) in a usable, presentable interface
Help the client's internal team figure out the front-end/backend connection points, since the backend is still being built out in parallel
Produce a demo that is polished enough to show to leadership as a credible "this is what it could look like" showcase, to support the case for continued funding
Contribute technical input on feasibility and approach, since the team is still deciding how to solve this problem architecturally
Required experience
Full-stack development experience, with a strong front-end focus in React
Demonstrated experience building interfaces/tools that sit on top of or surface outputs from data science / ML workflows
Comfort working in an early-stage, ambiguous project where the technical approach is still being defined
Ability to work independently and move fast to produce a convincing POC/demo
Fluent English (spoken and written)
Nice to Have
Data engineering background or experience working with data pipelines
Experience with PowerBI (understanding what the team is moving away from)
Experience integrating agentic AI systems or LLM-based chat features into a front-end application
Exposure to building or consuming simple ML models (e.g., decision trees) as well as more complex agentic architectures
General business/commercial analytics understanding—this project is about surfacing sales drivers, so comfort translating business questions into product features is a plus
Engagement highlights
High-visibility project: your work will be shown directly to leadership as part of a funding pitch
Ground-floor opportunity—you'll help shape the technical direction of a project that's still being defined, not just execute a locked spec
Full-time allocation with a real chance of extension beyond the initial 3 months
Flexible timezone options under consideration (LATAM, Canada, Europe)
Modern, product-facing work—genuinely building something new rather than maintaining legacy dashboards

mustCiteAny: Taking over and extending existing codebases

cases.notes: POSITIVE CONTROL: the CV has a section written as exactly this process. If this one fails, retrieval is broken, not grounding.

cases.question: Can you meet on Tuesday 22 September from 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM CEST?
cases.notes: Whether resolveZone places the bare abbreviation CEST is the measurement. If it cannot, the mention must be named as unchecked rather than silently answered.

cases.question: Disponibilidad para entrevista: martes 22/09 de 5:30 a 7:30 PM (hora de Madrid). ¿Te funciona?
cases.notes: The extraction generalisation case: a Spanish date format with a named city. A regex tuned to English phrasings is exactly what this is here to expose.

cases.question: Describe your experience serving as a CTO or VP of Engineering.
How many years have you led engineering teams of twenty or more people?
cases.notes: Tech lead and mentoring are on the CV; a twenty-person org is not.

cases.question: What is your expected hourly rate in USD?
cases.notes: Nothing in the profile is a rate. A number here is pure invention and the applicant is the one who has to honour it.

cases.question: What is your current visa status, and are you authorized to work in the United States?
cases.notes: The CV gives a country of residence and nothing about work authorization.

cases.question: Describe your production experience with Nuxt 4.
cases.notes: The CV says Nuxt with no version. Silently upgrading it to the version the question names is a claim nobody made.

cases.question: What have you built on Python 3.14?
cases.notes: The CV names Python 3.13 explicitly, which makes the wrong answer checkable.

cases.question: Our team is in Berlin. How many hours of daily overlap can you offer, and what are your working hours?
cases.notes: No Client's Hours attribute, so availability-evidence.ts must give the hours WITHOUT an overlap figure. An overlap number here is invented, and nothing else in the set tests it.
